info.description: Hero section with banner images, title, badge, and call-to-action button.

adminDisplayTitle.description: Internal name to identify this hero section in Strapi admin lists.

title.description: Main headline displayed prominently in the hero section.

style.description: Visual component style identifier (e.g. style-1, style-2).

badge.description: Top tag or promo badge text displayed above the headline (e.g. 'NEW ARRIVALS 2026').

description.description: Subtitle or introductory paragraph under the hero headline.

buttonText.description: Call-to-action button label (e.g. 'Shop Collection' or 'Explore Now').

buttonLink.description: Destination URL or relative storefront path for the CTA button (e.g. '/products' or '/collections/summer').

highlights.description: Trust badges or highlights displayed under the CTA button.

products.description: Select specific Medusa products to showcase in Hero styles (e.g. Hero Style-1 slides).

sideImages.description: Optional secondary or lifestyle images used in multi-image hero styles.
